_comment: PRs touching these paths pass Mirror review but are HELD for a human /code-review high + manual merge (deep-review hold) instead of auto-merging. Optional + graceful: a missing/malformed file, a non-list `paths`, or `enabled`:false all fall back to the code default in outbox_notifier._DEFAULT_DEEP_REVIEW_PATHS. Tuned by Pulse-Check. Globs are fnmatch'd against `gh pr view --json files` paths. A PR carrying the `deep-review-required` label also holds even if it touches none of these. A critical-path PR that Claude already /code-review high'd carries the `deep-review-passed` label and flows through Mirror to auto-merge normally.
_comment_dispatch_backstop: `scripts/heal_undispatched_pr_review.py` is listed for the same reason as `outbox_notifier.py`, its pair: it decides whether a PR gets a Mirror review AT ALL, and a Mirror PASS auto-merges. Its failure mode is quiet in the MERGE direction — an over-eager back-off just stops dispatching while the healer keeps logging and heartbeating normally, so PRs merge unreviewed and nothing raises a hand. Added 2026-07-28 with Larry's explicit sign-off, knowing the cost: every future change to that file now waits on a human.
_comment_approval_birth_gate: `scripts/heal_unregistered_approval.py` is the approval-card BIRTH GATE: it decides whether a stranded direction-ask ever becomes a card that reaches Larry AT ALL. Its paired handler `scripts/beacon_approval_handler.py` (listed above) governs a card that already EXISTS — the birth gate is strictly more dangerous, because a card wrongly suppressed at birth produces NO card, NO artifact, and NO alert on the tab to notice: the exact 'fails looking like success' case this fileset exists to catch. Two forge/* PRs (#1080 birth-probe, #1077 pending-approvals reconcile) auto-merged unreviewed on 2026-08-01 — #1080 despite its own capture demanding '/code-review high REQUIRED' — because this file was absent here. Added with the same trade the dispatch-backstop note records: lower churn than outbox_notifier.py, so the added human-review toil is small.
_comment_cross_repo: This list is REPO-AGNOSTIC — globs match a PR's file paths in whichever repo it was opened against. The `scripts/` and `config/` entries below therefore only ever match agent-core, and the RSDPM entries only ever match RSDPM. When onboarding another repo, add ITS critical paths here; nothing scopes this file to one repo, and an unlisted repo has NO durable hold at all (only the manual `deep-review-required` label).
